basis: closed-loop Simscape quarter-car plant with sprung and unsprung masses, tyre compliance, passive suspension, active actuator dynamics, and feedback control
dynamic mechanical coupling, dynamic actuator, robust feedback, and parameter-varying operation
five private conditions spanning two independent source-native axes and a comfort-handling-effort tradeoff
seven published time-series channels including the actual applied-force path

A.meaning: comfort, suspension-deflection, body/wheel travel, and force accuracy across all private conditions

Q.meaning: finite complete logs, exact public widths, units, and full 2 s coverage

M.meaning: connected sprung/unsprung, passive suspension, tyre, actuator, and road mechanisms

C.meaning: causal active-force response and feedback effects across road and plant interventions

R.meaning: worst-condition comfort, travel, and effort robustness

score_policy.within_group: task-specific weighted arithmetic aggregation with explicit worst-condition retention
score_policy.across_groups: weighted geometric mean; absent critical mechanism groups may be zero

minimum_shortcut_sanity_contract: same output replayed across all private conditions
road input copied directly to body or wheel outputs
